a72c0414b8.title: 'Baththa' OTT release: When is Vijay Sethupathi’s gangster comedy premiering on Netflix?
a72c0414b8.headline: Vijay Sethupathi's gangster comedy Baththa premieres on Netflix on 29 October
a72c0414b8.caption:
Vijay Sethupathi's Tamil action-comedy Baththa will debut digitally on Netflix on 29 October 2026. It will stream in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam. So fans across the South can watch it in their own language. The OTT release comes four weeks after its theatrical debut on 1 October.

The film is about an unusual encounter between a feared local gangster and an eight-year-old schoolboy. Vijay Sethupathi plays Baththavachalam, popularly known as Baththa, whose life turns upside down when the boy accidentally locks him inside a school restroom. Balaji Tharaneetharan directs, and Lijomol Jose plays one of the leads. It's the third collaboration between Vijay Sethupathi and Balaji Tharaneetharan, after Naduvula Konjam Pakkatha Kaanom and Seethakathi. The film earned praise from critics and audiences, though its box-office run was weaker than expected. Netflix could give it a second life.

21f8f78fdd.headline: ₹710 Cr worldwide: Jailer 2 becomes highest-grossing Tamil film ever
21f8f78fdd.caption:
Record broken! Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is now the biggest Tamil grosser of all time. The Nelson Dilipkumar film passed the ₹691 crore lifetime worldwide gross of 2.0 on 25 October 2026, its 11th day in theatres. It had released on 15 October 2026. Trade tracker Sacnilk puts its worldwide gross at ₹710.35 crore, which makes it the first Tamil film to cross ₹700 crore. In India it has earned ₹466.85 crore gross and ₹398.70 crore net, and it is expected to reach the ₹400 crore net mark soon. It also became the fastest Tamil film to reach ₹300 crore and ₹400 crore worldwide. The earlier record-holder, 2.0, also starred Rajinikanth, so the Superstar has now beaten his own mark.

Kollywood has experienced massive blockbuster successes over the years, but the elusive one thousand crore club remains unconquered.
